citations.excerpt: If skipkeys is false (the default), a TypeError will be raised when trying to encode keys that are not str, int, float, bool or None.

claims.text: By default (skipkeys=False), a TypeError is raised when trying to encode dictionary keys that are not str, int, float, bool or None.

citations.excerpt: skipkeys (bool) – If True, keys that are not of a basic type (str, int, float, bool, None) will be skipped instead of raising a TypeError. Default False.
If skipkeys is true, such items are simply skipped.

claims.text: With skipkeys=True, keys that are not of a basic type (str, int, float, bool, None) are simply skipped instead of raising a TypeError.

receipt.question: With json.dump, what happens by default to dictionary keys outside str, int, float, bool and None, and what happens with skipkeys=True?
